stats.timingNotes: Frame wall includes packing, HTTP, CUDA work and decoding. Frame 0 includes initialization/atlas upload; warm frames reuse the same native worker/context/buffers. Sequence cleanup is separate; depth one with caller backpressure. nativeTotalMs sums worker fit intervals (GPU, transfers, launch/synchronization and bookkeeping), excluding INIT, packet parsing, pre-timer result allocation and response serialization/pipe writes; null if unavailable on any tile.
